latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of dns-lookup skill.

- Perform DNS record lookups (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, CNAME, NS, SOA, ANY)
- Support for reverse DNS (PTR), domain WHOIS/RDAP lookups, and IP geolocation
- Simple API endpoints with example requests provided
- Free tier includes 10 queries per day; paid option available for higher limits
- No user authentication required for free usage; privacy-friendly with minimal data handling
